criteria.text: Given a ZIP over 100 MB or not a zip, when uploaded, then the response is 422 and nothing is written to `addon/`.

criteria.title: Upload endpoint and pre-install gates

criteria.title: Package inspection and extension.json manifest contract

criteria.title: Install: safe extraction into addon/slug and registry row upsert

criteria.title: Install: safe extraction into addon/slug and registry row upsert

criteria.title: Install: safe extraction into addon/slug and registry row upsert

criteria.title: Post-install migrations and cache clearing

criteria.title: Post-install migrations and cache clearing
criteria.text: Given the same package installed twice, when the second install runs, then no migration is applied twice.

criteria.title: Reply type: share a contact card

criteria.title: Reply type: send a catalog

criteria.title: Instagram-native triggers

criteria.title: Instagram-native triggers
criteria.text: Given a story_reply rule and a plain DM containing the keyword, then the rule does not fire.

criteria.title: Instagram-native triggers

criteria.title: Plan feature flag, rule cap, role gate and paywall overlay

criteria.title: Plan feature flag, rule cap, role gate and paywall overlay

criteria.title: Plan feature flag, rule cap, role gate and paywall overlay

criteria.title: Plan feature flag, rule cap, role gate and paywall overlay
criteria.text: Given a manager-role user, when opening `/auto-reply`, then 403.

criteria.title: Bot lookup endpoint: token auth, request contract, device and workspace resolution, audit row

criteria.title: Bot lookup endpoint: token auth, request contract, device and workspace resolution, audit row

criteria.title: Bot lookup endpoint: token auth, request contract, device and workspace resolution, audit row
criteria.text: Given a valid device and a matching rule, when called, then the response carries the rule's reply and an audit row links `matched_keyword_reply_id`.

criteria.title: Bot lookup endpoint: token auth, request contract, device and workspace resolution, audit row
criteria.text: Given an empty keyword and `media_type=image` on a device with a flow rule, then the flow is returned (TW-AR-032).

criteria.title: Bot lookup endpoint: token auth, request contract, device and workspace resolution, audit row
criteria.text: Given `phone` empty, then not-allowed.

criteria.title: Keyword matching semantics: candidate query, exact, contains, fuzzy, regex
criteria.text: Given keyword "hi, hello" with Exact, when a customer sends "Hello", then it matches; "hello there" does not.

criteria.title: Keyword matching semantics: candidate query, exact, contains, fuzzy, regex
criteria.text: Given keyword "hi" with Contains, when a customer sends "this is shipping", then it does not match; "hi there" does.

criteria.title: Keyword matching semantics: candidate query, exact, contains, fuzzy, regex
criteria.text: Given keyword "price|cost" as Regex, when a customer sends "What is the COST?", then it matches.

criteria.title: Keyword matching semantics: candidate query, exact, contains, fuzzy, regex
criteria.text: Given an invalid stored regex, then it never matches and never errors.

criteria.title: Keyword matching semantics: candidate query, exact, contains, fuzzy, regex
criteria.text: Given Fuzzy 80 with "pricing" on the dispatcher path and a customer message "pricng", then it does not match (documented behavior to be improved in the port).

criteria.title: Lookup resolution order and tie-breaking
criteria.text: Given a welcome rule and a keyword rule that both match a brand-new customer's "hi", then only the welcome greeting is sent.

criteria.title: Lookup resolution order and tie-breaking
criteria.text: Given rules "book" (flow) and a catch-all, when the customer types "book me", then the flow rule wins; when they type "asdf", the catch-all wins.

criteria.title: Lookup resolution order and tie-breaking
criteria.text: Given a keyword rule bound to device A and one to no device, both matching, then the lower id wins (device binding is not a priority tier for keyword rules).

criteria.title: Lookup resolution order and tie-breaking
criteria.text: Given a Korean message equal to a stored translation of "hello", then the rule fires with detected language ko.

criteria.title: Lookup resolution order and tie-breaking
criteria.text: Given a photo with no caption and an order-flow rule, then that flow starts.

criteria.title: Multilingual fallback and reply-language selection
criteria.text: Given a rule with canonical keyword "pricing" and reply "Our plans...", when a customer writes the Spanish equivalent and the provider detects es, then the rule fires and the reply is translated to Spanish.

criteria.title: Multilingual fallback and reply-language selection
criteria.text: Given the provider is down, then the canonical English reply is sent (or no match for the keyword).

criteria.title: Multilingual fallback and reply-language selection
criteria.text: Given a second customer writes in the same language within 24 h, then no provider call is made (cache).

criteria.title: Multilingual fallback and reply-language selection
criteria.text: Given a Devanagari message and no translation, then detected language is hi for reply selection.

criteria.title: Baileys auto-responder passes: welcome, away, out-of-hours, orphan self-heal
criteria.text: Given an away rule bound to a device id that no longer exists in the workspace and one live device, when Away mode is on and a customer writes, then the away reply is sent.

criteria.title: Baileys auto-responder passes: welcome, away, out-of-hours, orphan self-heal
criteria.text: Given a WABA-default workspace with a Baileys away rule, when a customer writes on the Baileys number with Away on, then the rule fires.

criteria.title: Baileys auto-responder passes: welcome, away, out-of-hours, orphan self-heal
criteria.text: Given two welcome rules priority 2 and 1, then priority 1 is tried first.

criteria.title: Auto-responder gate evaluator
criteria.text: Given a welcome rule with resend 1 hour and a fire 30 minutes ago on this conversation, then `resend_window` blocks it.

criteria.title: Auto-responder gate evaluator
criteria.text: Given agent-override on, an agent replied after the last fire, and the customer's previous message was 5 minutes ago with resume 1 hour, then the rule is paused.

criteria.title: Auto-responder gate evaluator
criteria.text: Given the same setup but the previous customer message was 2 hours ago, then it is not paused.

criteria.title: Auto-responder gate evaluator
criteria.text: Given an error reading messages, then the gate allows.

criteria.title: Auto-responder gate evaluator
criteria.text: Given overnight hours 22:00-06:00 and now 03:00, then in-hours.

criteria.title: Lookup post-match: flow liveness, billing check, counters, fire log
criteria.text: Given a flow rule whose flow is unpublished, when the keyword arrives, then the response is not-allowed and no counter changes.

criteria.title: Lookup post-match: flow liveness, billing check, counters, fire log
criteria.text: Given a matched rule, when the lookup returns, then `trigger_count` increased by one and one `keyword_reply_logs` row exists.

criteria.title: Lookup post-match: flow liveness, billing check, counters, fire log
criteria.text: Given send-time billing on, an exhausted plan and an empty wallet, then the response is not-allowed with reason plan_limit and the audit row still points at the rule.

criteria.title: Lookup post-match: flow liveness, billing check, counters, fire log
criteria.text: Given a logging failure, then the reply is still returned.

criteria.title: Lookup reply payloads and placeholder resolution
criteria.text: Given an image variant with caption "Hi {{first_name}}" and a known contact "Sara Ali", then the reply JSON carries the file URL and caption "Hi Sara".

criteria.title: Lookup reply payloads and placeholder resolution
criteria.text: Given a template with body "Order {{1}}" and variable_map slot 1 -> order_id and a workspace attribute order_id = 55, then the reply is "Order 55".

criteria.title: Lookup reply payloads and placeholder resolution
criteria.text: Given text "Hi {{ name }}" (spaces) and a known contact, then Laravel leaves it and the bridge fills it from the WhatsApp profile name.

criteria.title: Lookup reply payloads and placeholder resolution
criteria.text: Given a rule with no selected variant, then not-allowed.

criteria.title: Node bridge consumption: cooldown, delay, send, inbox mirror
criteria.text: Given cooldown 60 and two "price" messages 10 s apart from one customer, then one reply is sent.

criteria.title: Node bridge consumption: cooldown, delay, send, inbox mirror
criteria.text: Given a flow keyword typed during the cooldown, then the flow still starts.

criteria.title: Node bridge consumption: cooldown, delay, send, inbox mirror
criteria.text: Given reply_delay 5, then the send occurs about 5 s after the lookup response.

criteria.title: Node bridge consumption: cooldown, delay, send, inbox mirror
criteria.text: Given a welcome fired 5 minutes ago with a 24 h window, when the customer sends "price" (a non-flow keyword), then no reply is sent (documented quirk to remove in the port).

criteria.title: Dispatcher path for WABA, Twilio and channel bridges
criteria.text: Given a keyword rule and a WABA inbound "price", then a reply is sent via the WABA sender and an outbound bubble with `meta.source=auto_reply` exists.

criteria.title: Dispatcher path for WABA, Twilio and channel bridges
criteria.text: Given the operator's own number appears as the sender, then nothing is sent.

criteria.title: Dispatcher path for WABA, Twilio and channel bridges
criteria.text: Given a Telegram conversation with an assigned AI agent, then the keyword rules are not evaluated.

criteria.title: Dispatcher path for WABA, Twilio and channel bridges
criteria.text: Given the Meta agent is fronting the workspace, then no auto-reply is sent.

criteria.title: Dispatcher path for WABA, Twilio and channel bridges
criteria.text: Given a wizard-created "Any message" rule on WABA, then it does not fire (documented gap; the port should support it).

criteria.title: Dispatcher reply builders: all reply types, delay, flow enrolment
criteria.text: Given a text rule "Hi {{first_name}}" and contact "Sara Ali", then the outbound body is "Hi Sara".

criteria.title: Dispatcher reply builders: all reply types, delay, flow enrolment
criteria.text: Given a template rule on a WABA workspace, then a template message is sent with the template's name and language.

criteria.title: Dispatcher reply builders: all reply types, delay, flow enrolment
criteria.text: Given a rule with timeout 10, then the send starts after the webhook response and is capped at 30 seconds of delay.

criteria.title: Dispatcher reply builders: all reply types, delay, flow enrolment
criteria.text: Given a media rule with a stored file, then the outbound message has media path/type and the caption.

criteria.title: Dispatcher reply builders: all reply types, delay, flow enrolment
criteria.text: Given a flow rule, then the contact is enrolled and no message is sent by this service.

criteria.title: Conversation-level auto-reply guard
criteria.text: Given any conversation, when `canAutoReply` is asked, then it is true.

criteria.title: Conversation-level auto-reply guard
criteria.text: Given a fire, then `routing_meta.last_auto_reply_at` is updated.

criteria.title: Flow-managed keyword rules (flow trigger sync)
criteria.text: Given a published, active flow with trigger keywords "book, reserve", when saved, then an active `is_flow_trigger` rule with `contains` and those keywords exists.

criteria.title: Flow-managed keyword rules (flow trigger sync)
criteria.text: Given the flow is paused, then the rule exists with `status=false`.

criteria.text: Given the flow is deleted, then the rule is gone.

criteria.text: Given trigger keyword "any", then a catch-all rule with empty keyword exists.

criteria.text: Given an agent role, then the page is not reachable.

criteria.text: Given `--workspace=5`, then only that workspace's rules are processed.

criteria.title: Broadcast list page: filters, search, range, pagination, live refresh
criteria.text: Given a workspace with 30 broadcasts, When an admin opens `/broadcasts`, Then 12 rows are shown newest first, the footer reads "Showing 12 of 30 filtered broadcasts" and pagination shows 3 pages.

criteria.text: Given the admin clicks the "Failed" pill and types "may" in search, When the debounce fires, Then only failed broadcasts whose decrypted name contains "may" (case-insensitive) are shown, the URL becomes `?status=failed&q=may` and the tiles/pill counts are unchanged (they are workspace-wide).

criteria.title: Broadcast list page: filters, search, range, pagination, live refresh
criteria.text: Given a user with workspace role agent, When they open `/broadcasts`, Then they are redirected to `/team-inbox` with the warning "Your role (agent) doesn't have access to that page."

criteria.text: Given a broadcast is processing on Node, When 15 seconds pass with the tab visible, Then the row counts and status update without a page reload; with the tab hidden no request is made.

criteria.text: Given a request with `Accept: application/json` and `partial=1`, When the server responds, Then the body contains `ok`, `rows`, `stats`, `statusCounts`, `pagination`, `shown`, `total`, `page`.

criteria.title: New-broadcast channel chooser

criteria.text: Given the modal is open, When the admin clicks the dark backdrop, Then it closes without navigating.

criteria.title: Compose page: data loading, defaults and layout

criteria.title: Compose page: data loading, defaults and layout
criteria.text: Given a session error flash, When the page renders, Then a red banner shows it above the form.

criteria.text: Given a template with an IMAGE header, When selected, Then the preview shows the image; given a VIDEO header, Then it shows a "Video preview" chip.

criteria.text: Given no approved templates exist, When the page loads, Then the select has only the placeholder option and the "Create one" link is shown.

criteria.text: Given the admin clears the selection, When the change event fires, Then the preview resets to "Pick a template to preview…" and the category chip to a dash.

criteria.text: Given two connected senders, When the admin ticks both and sets weights 7 and 3, Then the badges show 70% and 30%.

criteria.text: Given one connected sender, When the page renders, Then no checkbox list is shown and the form posts that sender's key automatically.

criteria.text: Given no connected sender, When the page renders, Then "No connected devices." and the connect action are shown.

criteria.title: Sender picker with multi-device share weights
criteria.text: Given one row is unticked, When weights change, Then its badge shows a dash and its weight input is non-interactive.

criteria.title: Audience picker: contacts, groups and tags
criteria.text: Given 3 tags, When the page loads, Then each chip shows the number of distinct contacts carrying it.

criteria.title: Audience picker: contacts, groups and tags
criteria.text: Given the admin types "ravi", When rows filter, Then non-matching rows are hidden and unticked and the counter updates.

criteria.title: Audience picker: contacts, groups and tags
criteria.text: Given select-all is ticked while a search hides some rows, When toggled, Then only visible rows change.

criteria.title: Audience picker: contacts, groups and tags
criteria.text: Given the workspace has no contacts, When the page loads, Then the "No contacts yet" row with an "Add some" link is shown.

criteria.text: Given "Schedule for later" is clicked, When the card toggles, Then the date/time/timezone fields appear and the label shows "Later".

criteria.text: Given "Send now" is selected, When the form submits, Then `schedule_type=now` is posted along with the (hidden) timezone.

criteria.title: Schedule selector: send now or later
criteria.text: Given the default state, When the page loads, Then "Send now" is selected and the label reads "Now".

criteria.title: Store request: authorization, plan gates and validation
criteria.text: Given a plan with `broadcast` off, When an admin POSTs, Then the request is refused with the plan-feature-disabled message and nothing is created.

criteria.title: Store request: authorization, plan gates and validation
criteria.text: Given `broadcast_limit=5` and 5 existing broadcasts in the workspace, When the admin submits, Then it is refused with a limit-reached message; after deleting one it succeeds.

criteria.title: Store request: authorization, plan gates and validation
criteria.text: Given `schedule_type=later` without `send_date`, When submitted, Then a validation error on `send_date` is shown and the form keeps its old values.

criteria.title: Store request: authorization, plan gates and validation
criteria.text: Given `template_id` of another workspace's template, When submitted, Then the redirect shows "Selected template was not found in your workspace."

criteria.title: Store request: authorization, plan gates and validation
criteria.text: Given a name longer than 255 chars, When submitted, Then validation fails.

criteria.text: Given contact 5 is ticked and also belongs to a selected group, When the audience resolves, Then it is attached once.

criteria.title: Audience resolution, workspace scoping and opt-out removal
criteria.text: Given a selected tag whose id belongs to another workspace, When resolving, Then that tag contributes nothing.

criteria.text: Given every selected contact has `is_unsubscribed=true`, When submitted, Then the request fails with the "Select at least one contact or group" message and no broadcast is created.

criteria.text: Given a forged contact id from another workspace exists globally, When submitted, Then it is silently dropped and the broadcast is created with the remaining ids.

criteria.text: Given a pay-per-message workspace with a zero wallet, When it submits a 100-recipient broadcast, Then it is refused with the wallet message and no broadcast/recipient row exists.

criteria.title: Wallet precheck before a blast (and what the SendGate does not do)
criteria.text: Given a plan-quota workspace with a zero wallet, When it submits, Then it proceeds.

criteria.title: Wallet precheck before a blast (and what the SendGate does not do)
criteria.text: Given the emergency halt is engaged, When a broadcast is submitted, Then (Reference behavior) creation still proceeds; the port should refuse it.

criteria.title: Template pre-flight guards (auth block, media reachability, WABA quality)

criteria.title: Template pre-flight guards (auth block, media reachability, WABA quality)
criteria.text: Given a template paused until tomorrow, When submitted, Then the reason includes the pause end time.

criteria.title: WhatsApp Warmer hold and budget reservation
criteria.text: Given a warming number with 20 messages left today, When an immediate 50-recipient broadcast is submitted on it, Then it is held with the "only 20 ... remains" message and nothing is created.

criteria.title: WhatsApp Warmer hold and budget reservation
criteria.text: Given a warming number outside its active hours, When an immediate broadcast is submitted, Then it is held with the active-hours message; a scheduled broadcast for tomorrow is checked against tomorrow's budget instead.

criteria.title: WhatsApp Warmer hold and budget reservation
criteria.text: Given the warmer is disabled on the number, When submitted, Then no reservation and no `warmerGap` are applied.

criteria.title: WhatsApp Warmer hold and budget reservation
criteria.text: Given the broadcast passes, When rows are created, Then the ledger for the send date increases by the slice size.

criteria.title: Multi-device audience split and per-sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given 10 contacts and weights 7/3, When submitted, Then two broadcasts are created with 7 and 3 recipients respectively.

criteria.title: Multi-device audience split and per-sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given 10 contacts and 3 equal weights, When submitted, Then sizes are 4/3/3 (remainder goes to the first largest fractions) and every contact appears once.

criteria.title: Multi-device audience split and per-sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given 1 contact and 2 senders, When submitted, Then exactly one broadcast is created and the empty slice is skipped.

criteria.title: Multi-device audience split and per-sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given weights 5 and 0, When submitted, Then the 0-weight sender is treated as weight 1 (documented Reference behavior).

criteria.title: Persisting broadcasts and recipient rows; schedule instant

criteria.title: Persisting broadcasts and recipient rows; schedule instant

criteria.title: Persisting broadcasts and recipient rows; schedule instant
criteria.text: Given the template overrides contain only blank values, When saved, Then `template_overrides` is null.

criteria.title: Gmail outbound: reply and new message with correct threading
criteria.text: Given a thread from a customer, When an agent replies, Then the customer's client shows the reply in the same thread, from the mailbox address.

criteria.title: Gmail outbound: reply and new message with correct threading
criteria.text: Given the send fails with a network error, When retried with the same reference, Then exactly one mail is delivered.

criteria.title: Gmail outbound: reply and new message with correct threading
criteria.text: Given the mailbox is `needs_reauth`, When sending, Then the row fails with the reconnect message.

criteria.title: Several mailboxes per workspace (limit of 2 to 3, per-mailbox defaults)

criteria.title: Several mailboxes per workspace (limit of 2 to 3, per-mailbox defaults)
criteria.text: Given a default assignee on sales@, When a new thread arrives there, Then it is assigned to that user; an existing thread's assignee is untouched.

criteria.title: Several mailboxes per workspace (limit of 2 to 3, per-mailbox defaults)
criteria.text: Given one mailbox is disconnected, When counting, Then the usage is 2 of 3.

criteria.title: Multi-inbox view in the inbox: mailbox switcher, filter, counts, From selector
criteria.text: Given support@ and sales@ connected, When the inbox opens, Then the Email group shows both with their own unread counts.

criteria.title: Multi-inbox view in the inbox: mailbox switcher, filter, counts, From selector
criteria.text: Given the agent selects sales@, When the list reloads, Then only threads of that mailbox show.

criteria.title: Multi-inbox view in the inbox: mailbox switcher, filter, counts, From selector
criteria.text: Given a thread of support@, When replying, Then the From is support@ and cannot be changed.

criteria.title: Multi-inbox view in the inbox: mailbox switcher, filter, counts, From selector
criteria.text: Given a team-scoped agent, When counts load, Then they include only visible threads.

criteria.title: One conversation per email thread, contact linked by email identity
criteria.text: Given a reply with matching `In-Reply-To`, When ingested, Then it joins the existing conversation and reopens it if resolved.

criteria.title: One conversation per email thread, contact linked by email identity
criteria.text: Given a new subject from the same sender, When ingested, Then a new conversation links to the same contact.

criteria.title: One conversation per email thread, contact linked by email identity
criteria.text: Given the contact quota is reached, When a new sender writes, Then the message is stored, unlinked and flagged.

criteria.title: Rich inbound message: sanitised HTML, cc, headers, attachments
criteria.text: Given a mail with a 2 MB PDF and an inline logo, When ingested, Then the PDF is downloadable and the logo renders inline.

criteria.title: Rich inbound message: sanitised HTML, cc, headers, attachments
criteria.text: Given an HTML mail with a script and a tracking image, When displayed, Then the script is gone and the image is not loaded until the agent allows it.

criteria.title: Rich inbound message: sanitised HTML, cc, headers, attachments
criteria.text: Given an attachment over the cap, When ingested, Then the message shows "attachment too large" and ingest does not fail.

criteria.title: Composer: rich text, cc/bcc, attachments, signature, saved replies
criteria.text: Given a mailbox signature, When an agent opens the composer, Then it is appended and still editable.

criteria.title: Composer: rich text, cc/bcc, attachments, signature, saved replies
criteria.text: Given two attachments and a cc, When sent, Then the customer receives both files and the cc address is on the mail.

criteria.title: Composer: rich text, cc/bcc, attachments, signature, saved replies
criteria.text: Given a send failure, When the agent retries, Then the draft and files are still there.

criteria.title: Mailbox health: sync status, last error, needs-reauth, reconnect, retry
criteria.text: Given Google revokes the grant, When the next sync runs, Then the mailbox shows Needs reconnect and one notification is created.

criteria.title: Mailbox health: sync status, last error, needs-reauth, reconnect, retry
criteria.text: Given the admin reconnects the same address, When done, Then syncing resumes and mail from the outage is imported.

criteria.title: Mailbox health: sync status, last error, needs-reauth, reconnect, retry
criteria.text: Given the admin signs in with a different address, When reconnecting, Then the flow is refused.

criteria.title: Operator console: Email providers (Google credentials, enable, test)
criteria.text: Given no Google credentials, When a workspace admin opens Connect, Then Google shows the "ask your platform administrator" state.

criteria.title: Operator console: Email providers (Google credentials, enable, test)
criteria.text: Given valid credentials saved, When Test runs, Then it reports success and the secret is shown masked.

criteria.title: Operator console: Email providers (Google credentials, enable, test)
criteria.text: Given a non-platform user, When the page is requested, Then it is refused.

criteria.title: Permissions, plan feature and the mailbox limit key
criteria.text: Given a member without `mail.mailboxes.manage`, When calling connect, Then 403.

criteria.title: Permissions, plan feature and the mailbox limit key
criteria.text: Given a plan without `channel_email`, When opening Settings, Then the Email tile shows the upgrade state.

criteria.title: Permissions, plan feature and the mailbox limit key
criteria.text: Given the limit reached, When connecting, Then the limit error code is returned.

criteria.title: Generic IMAP/SMTP mailbox ("Other mail")
criteria.text: Given a wrong SMTP password, When saving, Then nothing is saved and the error names SMTP.

criteria.title: Generic IMAP/SMTP mailbox ("Other mail")
criteria.text: Given correct settings, When saved, Then a backfill starts and mail arrives as threads.

criteria.title: Loop, bounce and auto-responder protection
criteria.text: Given an out-of-office reply, When ingested, Then no auto-reply or flow starts.

criteria.title: Loop, bounce and auto-responder protection
criteria.text: Given a delivery-failure notice, When ingested, Then the original outbound message shows bounced.

criteria.title: Loop, bounce and auto-responder protection
criteria.text: Given mail from the workspace's other mailbox, When ingested, Then automation does not respond.

criteria.title: Gmail push notifications (Pub/Sub watch) instead of polling
criteria.text: Given a watch is active, When mail arrives, Then it shows in the inbox within seconds.

criteria.title: Gmail push notifications (Pub/Sub watch) instead of polling
criteria.text: Given a watch expires, When the renewal job runs, Then it is renewed.

criteria.title: Microsoft 365 / Outlook by OAuth
criteria.text: mirrors `TW-MAIL-020` and `TW-MAIL-021` for a Microsoft account.

criteria.title: Personal mailboxes and the channel-owner visibility rule
criteria.text: Given a personal mailbox of agent A, When agent B opens the inbox, Then A's threads are not visible or countable.

criteria.title: Personal mailboxes and the channel-owner visibility rule
criteria.text: Given the policy allows admins, When an admin opens the inbox, Then they can see them.

criteria.title: Connect an account: OAuth redirect, embedded popup, pasted Page token
criteria.text: Given a valid code, When the callback runs, Then each managed Page exists with its own token. Given a wrong `state`, Then nothing is stored. Given a token that is not a Page's, Then manual connect says so.

criteria.title: Ingest one message: thread, dedup, preview, window, unread, contact, buttons
criteria.text: Given the same message by push then pull, Then one row. Given a first message with only a numeric handle and a later one with a name, Then the title updates. Given an outbound message, Then no unread increment.

criteria.title: SMS hub page: connected numbers, status, lookup tool, setup guide
criteria.text: Given a workspace with one Twilio and one MSG91 sender, When `/sms` opens, Then both appear oldest first, the MSG91 card shows its DLT sender and DLT template rows and the Twilio card does not, and the pill reads "2 numbers active".

criteria.title: SMS hub page: connected numbers, status, lookup tool, setup guide
criteria.text: Given a workspace with no senders, When `/sms` opens, Then the empty state and the connect form show and the pill reads "Not connected".

criteria.title: SMS hub page: connected numbers, status, lookup tool, setup guide
criteria.text: Given a plan without `access_sms`, When the page is requested, Then it renders under the paywall and no action on it succeeds.

criteria.title: SMS hub page: connected numbers, status, lookup tool, setup guide
criteria.text: Given a deactivated sender, When listed, Then it shows "Inactive", is not counted in the pill and offers "Activate".

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given valid Twilio credentials and a From number, When submitted, Then a connected sender exists with encrypted credentials, the label "SMS · Twilio", the rate and currency, and the user lands on `/sms` with the success flash.

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given the same From number submitted again with a new rate, When saved, Then there is still one row and the rate is updated.

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given credentials the provider rejects, When submitted, Then nothing is saved and the reason shows on the form with the entered values kept.

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given a plan without `access_sms`, When submitted, Then it is refused with the plan message and nothing is saved.

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given a workspace at its device cap, When a new From number is submitted, Then it is refused with the limit message; Given the same From number as an existing sender, Then the update succeeds.

criteria.title: Connect an SMS sender (Twilio or MSG91 form, validation, upsert)
criteria.text: Given `sms_provider = telegram`, When submitted, Then "The selected sms provider is invalid." shows.

criteria.title: Twilio credential check and reuse of the workspace's Twilio keys
criteria.text: Given a workspace that already connected Twilio for WhatsApp, When the SID and token are left blank, Then the sender is saved with those credentials after they verify.

criteria.title: Twilio credential check and reuse of the workspace's Twilio keys
criteria.text: Given an SID starting with "SK", When submitted, Then the API-key message shows and nothing is saved.

criteria.title: Twilio credential check and reuse of the workspace's Twilio keys
criteria.text: Given wrong credentials, When submitted, Then "Twilio rejected those credentials: ..." shows with Twilio's reason.

criteria.title: Twilio credential check and reuse of the workspace's Twilio keys
criteria.text: Given Twilio is unreachable, When submitted, Then "Could not reach Twilio: ..." shows.

criteria.title: MSG91 auth key check
criteria.text: Given a valid auth key, When submitted, Then the sender is saved with the label "SMS · MSG91".

criteria.title: MSG91 auth key check
criteria.text: Given a key that gets HTTP 200 with an error body, When submitted, Then "MSG91 rejected that auth key." shows and nothing is saved.

criteria.title: MSG91 auth key check
criteria.text: Given a blank key, When submitted, Then "An MSG91 auth key is required." shows.

criteria.title: India DLT fields: sender id, DLT template id, flow versus plain mode
criteria.text: Given an MSG91 sender with a DLT template id, When a message is sent, Then the flow route is used and the DLT sender id is passed as the sender.

criteria.title: India DLT fields: sender id, DLT template id, flow versus plain mode
criteria.text: Given an MSG91 sender with no DLT template id, When a message is sent, Then the plain route is used (TW-SMS-012).

criteria.title: India DLT fields: sender id, DLT template id, flow versus plain mode
criteria.text: Given a Twilio sender with a stored DLT id, When it sends, Then the DLT id has no effect.

criteria.title: India DLT fields: sender id, DLT template id, flow versus plain mode
criteria.text: Given an 18-character sender id, When submitted, Then "The sender id field must not be greater than 16 characters." shows.

criteria.title: Activate or deactivate a sender
criteria.text: Given a connected sender, When toggled, Then it is disconnected, the flash says "deactivated" and it disappears from the pickers.

criteria.title: Activate or deactivate a sender
criteria.text: Given a sender id of another workspace, When toggled, Then "SMS number not found." and nothing changes.

criteria.title: Activate or deactivate a sender
criteria.text: Given a deactivated sender chosen by a scheduled campaign, When the campaign fires, Then it fails with "No sendable SMS number connected".

criteria.title: Remove a sender
criteria.text: Given a sender, When removed, Then it and its credentials are gone and the list updates.

criteria.title: Remove a sender
criteria.text: Given a campaign pointing at the removed sender and another connected sender existing, When the campaign runs, Then it sends from the other sender (documented Reference behaviour).

criteria.title: Remove a sender
criteria.text: Given an id that does not exist, When removed, Then the flash is still "SMS number removed." and nothing else changes.

criteria.title: Number lookup: mobile, landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)
criteria.text: Given a mobile number, When checked, Then the line reads "Mobile — can receive SMS." plus the carrier and is green.

criteria.title: Number lookup: mobile, landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)
criteria.text: Given a landline, When checked, Then `textable` is false and the line warns it is charged and lost.

criteria.title: Number lookup: mobile, landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)
criteria.text: Given the same number checked twice, When the second call runs, Then `cached` is true and Twilio is not called.

criteria.title: Number lookup: mobile, landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)
criteria.text: Given a workspace with no connected sender, When checked, Then "Connect a Twilio SMS number first."

criteria.title: Number lookup: mobile, landline or invalid (Twilio Lookup)
criteria.text: Given empty or non-digit input, When checked, Then nothing is sent from the screen (empty) or "That is not a phone number." returns (non-digit).

criteria.title: Segment and encoding calculation (GSM-7 versus UCS-2)
criteria.text: Given 160 GSM characters, When measured, Then 1 segment, "GSM-7", 160 units, 0 remaining.

criteria.title: Segment and encoding calculation (GSM-7 versus UCS-2)
criteria.text: Given 161 GSM characters, When measured, Then 2 segments, 153 per segment, 145 remaining.

criteria.title: Segment and encoding calculation (GSM-7 versus UCS-2)
criteria.text: Given "Hello 😀", When measured, Then encoding "UCS-2", 1 segment, per_segment 70.

criteria.title: Segment and encoding calculation (GSM-7 versus UCS-2)
criteria.text: Given 3 euro signs, When measured, Then 6 units and "GSM-7".

criteria.title: Segment and encoding calculation (GSM-7 versus UCS-2)
criteria.text: Given 71 UCS-2 characters, When measured, Then 2 segments of 67 and the warning names 67 characters per SMS and 2 messages.

criteria.title: Provider seam: sendable check, phone normalisation, never-throw contract
criteria.text: Given a sender with no auth token, When a send is attempted, Then it returns `ok=false` with the "no credentials" text and no HTTP call is made.

criteria.title: Provider seam: sendable check, phone normalisation, never-throw contract
criteria.text: Given the recipient "(415) 555-1234" and a Twilio sender, When sent, Then the number is `+4155551234`.

criteria.title: Provider seam: sendable check, phone normalisation, never-throw contract
criteria.text: Given an alphanumeric Twilio From "ACMEIN", When sent, Then From is `ACMEIN` unchanged.

criteria.text: Given a whitespace-only body, When sent, Then "Nothing to send — the message is empty." and no call is made.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through Twilio
criteria.text: Given a connected Twilio sender, When a message is sent, Then Twilio receives From, To, Body and the https status callback and our result carries the Twilio sid and segment count.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through Twilio
criteria.text: Given Twilio returns error 21211, When sent, Then the error text tells the operator to use full international format, e.g. +919876543210.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through Twilio
criteria.text: Given Twilio is unreachable, When sent, Then the result is `ok=false` with "Could not reach the SMS provider: ...".

criteria.title: Send one SMS through MSG91 (DLT flow route or plain route)
criteria.text: Given a sender with a DLT template id and sender id, When a message is sent, Then the flow route is called with that template, the text in `VAR1` and `body`, and the sender.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through MSG91 (DLT flow route or plain route)
criteria.text: Given a sender with no DLT template id and no sender id, When a message is sent, Then the plain route is called with sender `MSGIND`, route `4`.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through MSG91 (DLT flow route or plain route)
criteria.text: Given MSG91 returns HTTP 200 with type "error", When sent, Then the result is `ok=false` with the translated message.

criteria.title: Send one SMS through MSG91 (DLT flow route or plain route)
criteria.text: Given success, When the result is read, Then `message_id` is the MSG91 request id and `segments` is the local count.

criteria.title: Provider error translation into operator messages
criteria.text: Given Twilio error 21610, When a send fails, Then the recipient error explains STOP and START.

criteria.title: Provider error translation into operator messages
criteria.text: Given MSG91 message "Invalid sender ID", When a send fails, Then the translated text names the 6-letter DLT rule and keeps the original in brackets.

criteria.title: Provider error translation into operator messages
criteria.text: Given an unknown Twilio code, When a send fails, Then Twilio's own message is stored.

criteria.title: Merge variables ({{token}}) in SMS bodies
criteria.text: Given the body "Hi {{first_name}}, your code is {{ city }}" and a contact with those values, When personalised, Then both are substituted (case and spacing tolerant).

criteria.title: Merge variables ({{token}}) in SMS bodies
criteria.text: Given a contact with no value for a token, When personalised, Then the token is replaced with an empty string and the rest is sent.

criteria.title: Merge variables ({{token}}) in SMS bodies
criteria.text: Given a body saved as "Hi {{1}}" with the map {1: first_name}, When the port sends it, Then the recipient sees the first name (Reference sends an empty string; this is the intended behaviour).

criteria.title: Merge variables ({{token}}) in SMS bodies
criteria.text: Given a body that becomes empty after substitution, When sent, Then the recipient is marked failed with "Empty phone or message".

criteria.title: SMS templates: local plain-text messages
criteria.text: Given SMS on and a connected sender, When creating a template, Then the SMS channel is offered and the saved template is immediately approved.

criteria.title: SMS templates: local plain-text messages
criteria.text: Given no connected sender, When creating a template, Then the SMS channel is not offered.

criteria.title: SMS templates: local plain-text messages
criteria.text: Given a body over 4096 characters, When saved, Then the shared "max 4096" validation rejects it.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast: chooser card, composer, audience, sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given SMS enabled and a connected sender, When the broadcasts screen loads, Then the SMS card shows; Given no connected sender, Then it does not.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast: chooser card, composer, audience, sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given two SMS senders ticked with weights 3 and 1 and 100 contacts, When submitted, Then two broadcasts are created with 75 and 25 recipients and names suffixed with the sender label.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast: chooser card, composer, audience, sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given an audience that is entirely opted out, When submitted, Then the "Select at least one contact or group" error shows and nothing is created.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast: chooser card, composer, audience, sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given an OTP-type template, When submitted, Then it is refused with the authentication message.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast: chooser card, composer, audience, sender fan-out
criteria.text: Given `schedule_type = later` with no date, When submitted, Then the date is required.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast runner: sequential send, counters, status
criteria.text: Given a broadcast of 3 contacts where one has no phone, When run, Then 2 are sent and the contact with no phone is not part of the run.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast runner: sequential send, counters, status
criteria.text: Given 1 success and 1 failure, When run, Then the status is `completed_with_errors`, `success_count` = 1, `fail_count` = 1, and the failed recipient carries the provider text.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast runner: sequential send, counters, status
criteria.text: Given all sends fail, When run, Then the status is `failed`.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast runner: sequential send, counters, status
criteria.text: Given the sender was deactivated, When run, Then the broadcast is `failed` with "No sendable SMS number connected" and no HTTP call is made.

criteria.title: SMS broadcast runner: sequential send, counters, status
criteria.text: Given the monthly cap is reached, When run, Then the broadcast is `failed` and nothing is sent.

criteria.title: SMS campaign builder: chooser card, fields kept and fields ignored
criteria.text: Given SMS on and a connected sender, When the campaigns screen loads, Then the SMS card shows; the SMS builder shows no template or flow tile.

criteria.title: SMS campaign builder: chooser card, fields kept and fields ignored
criteria.text: Given a custom SMS campaign with 3 contacts and 2 pasted numbers (one with 6 digits), When saved, Then 4 recipients are created (the 6-digit number is dropped) and the status is `running` for now.

criteria.title: SMS campaign builder: chooser card, fields kept and fields ignored
criteria.text: Given `schedule_type = scheduled` with no date, When saved, Then it stays `scheduled` waiting for the sweeper.

criteria.title: SMS campaign builder: chooser card, fields kept and fields ignored
criteria.text: Given the total campaigns quota is used up, When saved, Then the quota message shows and nothing is created.

criteria.title: SMS campaign builder: chooser card, fields kept and fields ignored
criteria.text: Given an A/B-enabled SMS campaign, When run, Then every recipient gets variant A text (Reference); the port should either send B text to B recipients or hide the A/B control.

criteria.title: SMS campaign runner: sequential send, per-recipient rows, KPI recompute
criteria.text: Given a campaign with 5 recipients, one opted out, When run, Then 4 messages are sent, the opted-out one is skipped and the status becomes `completed`.

criteria.title: SMS campaign runner: sequential send, per-recipient rows, KPI recompute
criteria.text: Given one provider failure among successes, When run, Then the status is `completed_with_errors` and the campaign `sent_count` reflects the successes.

criteria.title: SMS campaign runner: sequential send, per-recipient rows, KPI recompute
criteria.text: Given a crash mid-run and a later re-fire of a one-shot campaign, When it runs again, Then already-sent recipients are not sent twice.

criteria.title: SMS campaign runner: sequential send, per-recipient rows, KPI recompute
criteria.text: Given a recurring campaign, When its next cadence fires, Then every non-opted-out recipient is sent to again.

criteria.title: Scheduling and recurrence for SMS sends
criteria.text: Given a campaign scheduled for 10:00 in Asia/Kolkata, When the clock passes 10:00 there, Then it fires once and shows `running` then a final status.

criteria.title: Scheduling and recurrence for SMS sends
criteria.text: Given a recurring weekly campaign, When it completes a cadence, Then its next send date moves forward one week and its recipients are reset to queued.

criteria.title: Scheduling and recurrence for SMS sends
criteria.text: Given a broadcast scheduled for tomorrow, When the port is built, Then nothing is sent until tomorrow at the chosen time (Reference sends immediately; this is the deliberate fix).

criteria.title: Retries and resume: broadcast sweeper, manual retry, stalled campaign rescue
criteria.text: Given a broadcast with 2 failed recipients, When "Retry failed" is pressed, Then only those 2 are re-sent and the broadcast leaves `processing` with a final status.

criteria.title: Retries and resume: broadcast sweeper, manual retry, stalled campaign rescue
criteria.text: Given a failed recipient and attempts below the cap, When the sweeper ticks after the backoff, Then it is retried; Given the cap is reached, Then it is left for manual review.

criteria.title: Retries and resume: broadcast sweeper, manual retry, stalled campaign rescue
criteria.text: Given a broadcast with no failed recipients, When retried, Then HTTP 400 "No failed recipients to retry."

criteria.title: Retries and resume: broadcast sweeper, manual retry, stalled campaign rescue
criteria.text: Given a campaign killed mid-send, When more than 45 s pass, Then it is re-armed and finishes without re-sending the done recipients.

criteria.title: Delivery status callback and status mapping (Twilio and MSG91 DLR)

criteria.title: Delivery status callback and status mapping (Twilio and MSG91 DLR)

criteria.title: Delivery status callback and status mapping (Twilio and MSG91 DLR)

criteria.title: Delivery status callback and status mapping (Twilio and MSG91 DLR)
criteria.text: Given a malformed body, When received, Then 204.

criteria.title: Delivery roll-up into campaign analytics (and the broadcast gap)

criteria.title: Opt-out suppression on the send side

criteria.text: Given a Twilio 21610 failure, When recorded, Then the failure reads as the STOP explanation (flagging the contact is a pending decision).

criteria.title: Monthly SMS quota (`sms_monthly_limit`)
criteria.text: Given a cap of 0, When any run starts, Then there is no limit.

criteria.title: Start-from-template gallery and clone

criteria.title: Admin flow templates: list, visibility toggle, delete

criteria.title: Admin flow templates: list, visibility toggle, delete

criteria.title: Admin flow template create / edit

criteria.title: Admin flow template create / edit

criteria.title: Admin flow template create / edit
criteria.text: Given `sort_order` 10000, then validation fails.

criteria.title: Flow categories and the library filter

criteria.title: Canvas interactions, undo/redo and shortcuts

criteria.title: Canvas interactions, undo/redo and shortcuts
criteria.text: Given three moves then two Ctrl+Z presses, then the canvas returns to the state after the first move; Ctrl+Y re-applies.

criteria.title: Canvas interactions, undo/redo and shortcuts

criteria.title: Canvas interactions, undo/redo and shortcuts
criteria.text: Given a second Trigger drag, then a toast refuses it.

criteria.title: Node palette, search and per-channel availability
criteria.text: Given a WhatsApp flow, then Template, List, Sequence, MySQL and Google nodes are listed; given the Trigger channel is switched to Facebook, then only message, media, buttons, ask, condition, delay, webhook, ai, end and the five `fb_*` nodes are listed.

criteria.title: Node palette, search and per-channel availability
criteria.text: Given a call flow, then the palette shows the eight `cf_*` nodes plus Trigger, Condition, Wait, Webhook, Run code and End only.

criteria.title: Node palette, search and per-channel availability
criteria.text: Given the query "sheet", then only Google Sheets is listed.

criteria.title: Node card rendering, ports and handle naming
criteria.text: Given a Buttons node with options A, B, C, then it exposes ports `p0`, `p1`, `p2`.

criteria.title: Node card rendering, ports and handle naming
criteria.text: Given an Ask node with two expected answers, then ports `p0`, `p1` and `else` exist; with zero answers only `out`.

criteria.title: Node card rendering, ports and handle naming
criteria.text: Given a Condition node, then edges use the handles `yes` and `no` and normalise to ports 1 and 2.

criteria.title: Pre-save graph validation
criteria.text: Given a Message node with no incoming edge, when Save is clicked, then the popup lists `"Send message" is not connected to anything.` and the node is outlined red.

criteria.title: Pre-save graph validation
criteria.text: Given a WhatsApp-only Google Sheets node on a flow whose Trigger channel was switched to Instagram, then Save is blocked with the "does not work on Instagram" reason.

criteria.title: Pre-save graph validation
criteria.text: Given a workspace with connected numbers and a Trigger without a number, then Save is blocked; with no connected numbers it saves.

criteria.title: Save flow (create / update)
criteria.text: Given a new flow with a valid graph, when Save is confirmed with the name "Welcome", then a draft row exists (`is_published=false`, `is_active=true`), the URL becomes `/flows/builder/<id>` and a second Save updates the same row.

criteria.title: Save flow (create / update)
criteria.text: Given the workspace is at its plan limit, when creating, then the response is 422 with the plan message and no row is created; when editing an existing flow, the save succeeds.

criteria.title: Save flow (create / update)
criteria.text: Given a keyword trigger with 300 characters, then the save returns 422 with the "Trigger keyword is too long" message; note the row itself has already been updated by then (the hook runs after the write and there is no transaction), so the new graph is persisted although the operator saw an error.

criteria.title: Save flow (create / update)
criteria.text: Given a `flow_id` from another workspace, then 404.

criteria.title: Trigger column extraction and sender binding
criteria.text: Given trigger `{kind:'tag_added', tagId:'7', deviceId:'waba:3'}`, then the row gets `trigger_kind=tag_added`, `trigger_value=7`, `trigger_device_id=3`, `provider=waba`.

criteria.title: Trigger column extraction and sender binding
criteria.text: Given `{kind:'keyword', keywordMode:'any'}`, then `trigger_keywords='any'`.

criteria.title: Trigger column extraction and sender binding
criteria.text: Given `{kind:'order_placed'}`, then `trigger_value=0`.

criteria.title: Trigger column extraction and sender binding
criteria.text: Given `{kind:'nonsense'}`, then `trigger_kind='keyword'`.

criteria.title: Managed keyword-trigger rule sync
criteria.text: Given a published+active WhatsApp flow with keywords "price, cost" and a number pinned, then exactly one active managed rule exists; pausing the flow makes it inactive; deleting removes it.

criteria.title: Managed keyword-trigger rule sync
criteria.text: Given `keywordMode='any'`, then the rule is a catch-all with empty keyword and `matching_method='exact'`.

criteria.title: Managed keyword-trigger rule sync
criteria.text: Given a Facebook flow, then no `keyword_replies` row is created.

criteria.title: Managed keyword-trigger rule sync
criteria.text: Given a 300-char keyword string, then the sync throws and the operator sees the length message.

criteria.title: Publish and unpublish
criteria.text: Given a saved draft, when Publish is clicked, then `is_published=true`, `published_at` is set, the pill reads Published and its keyword rule becomes active.

criteria.title: Publish and unpublish
criteria.text: Given a flow with an unconnected node, when Publish is clicked, then nothing is saved and the red validation popup appears.

criteria.title: Publish and unpublish
criteria.text: Given a brand-new unsaved graph, when Publish is clicked, then exactly ONE flow row exists afterwards and it is published (target behaviour; Reference creates two).

criteria.title: Publish and unpublish
criteria.text: Given an API call to unpublish, then `is_published=false` and the rule goes inactive.

criteria.title: Flow variables modal
criteria.text: Given any builder session, then no control opens the Variables modal (parity), and saving stores `vars` as the two defaults.

criteria.title: Flow variables modal
criteria.text: Given a port that ships the feature, then declared defaults must resolve when a session variable is unset.

criteria.title: Test runner (simulate a chat) and webhook test endpoint
criteria.text: Given a flow Trigger -> Ask (var `name`) -> Message "Hi {{name}}", when the operator types "hello", answers "Sam", then the log shows the prompt, the reply and "Hi Sam".

criteria.title: Test runner (simulate a chat) and webhook test endpoint
criteria.text: Given a Webhook node pointed at `http://169.254.169.254/x`, when reached in test, then the log shows "webhook failed: Blocked: host resolves to a private/reserved IP (169.254.169.254)" and the flow continues via `out`.

criteria.title: Test runner (simulate a chat) and webhook test endpoint
criteria.text: Given a Condition with `plan equals pro` and the variable unset, then the log shows the NO branch.

criteria.title: Test runner (simulate a chat) and webhook test endpoint
criteria.text: Given a Buttons node whose port is unwired, when option 2 is chosen, then the log says `Port "p1" (option 2) not connected — stop.`

criteria.title: Generate a flow with AI
criteria.text: Given an enabled OpenAI key and the prompt "Greet the customer, ask their name, then offer a list of services", when Generate is clicked, then at most 20 nodes and 40 edges are placed with one START trigger.

criteria.title: Generate a flow with AI
criteria.text: Given no key for the selected provider, then the modal shows the `no_key` message.

criteria.title: Generate a flow with AI
criteria.text: Given the model replies with prose plus a fenced JSON block, then the fences and prose are stripped and the flow still loads.

criteria.title: Generate a flow with AI
criteria.text: Given a prompt over 2000 characters, then 422.

criteria.title: Builder reference-data endpoints (pickers)
criteria.text: Given a workspace with a WABA number id 3, when the picker is called, then `devices[0].key === 'waba:3'` and `engine_label` is the engine's display label.

criteria.title: Builder reference-data endpoints (pickers)
criteria.text: Given the workspace saved its own OpenAI key, then `models` contains only `OpenAI (your key) · ...` entries for OpenAI and still contains admin models for other providers.

criteria.title: Builder reference-data endpoints (pickers)
criteria.text: Given no `keyword_replies.ig_trigger` column, then `keywordRules` is `[]`.

criteria.title: Flow media upload and inbound media store
criteria.text: Given a 3 MB PNG uploaded as type `image`, then the response has an absolute `url` and the node shows a thumbnail.

criteria.title: Flow media upload and inbound media store
criteria.text: Given `shell.php` renamed to `.png`, then the upload is rejected with the content/type message.

criteria.text: Given a 60 MB video, then validation fails (max 51200 KB).

criteria.title: Flow media upload and inbound media store
criteria.text: Given a Node call to store-media with a 30 MB base64 body, then 413.

criteria.title: Plan, role and feature gates for flows
criteria.text: Given a manager, when opening `/flows`, then 403.

criteria.title: Plan, role and feature gates for flows

criteria.title: Flow persistence model (encrypted graph, file mirror, engine stamp)

criteria.title: Flow persistence model (encrypted graph, file mirror, engine stamp)
criteria.text: Given the row's `flow_data` is NULL but the mirror file exists, then the graph loads from the file.

criteria.title: Flow persistence model (encrypted graph, file mirror, engine stamp)
criteria.text: Given a delete, then the mirror file is removed.

criteria.title: Trigger node
criteria.text: Given a new canvas, when the admin drags the Trigger in, then it is pinned as START with kind Keyword, mode "On specific keywords", keywords `price, pricing, cost`, and a single output port labelled "on keyword"; a second drag shows the toast that the Trigger can only exist once.

criteria.title: Trigger node
criteria.text: Given kind `tag_added`, when the admin picks a tag and saves, then `data.tagId` is the tag id as a string, the keyword fields are hidden, and the saved flow row gets `trigger_kind=tag_added` and `trigger_value=<id>` (TW-FLB-020).

criteria.title: Trigger node
criteria.text: Given the Channel is switched from WhatsApp to Instagram, then `deviceId` is cleared, the sender list shows Instagram accounts only, the kind list gains the Comment -> DM option, and the palette re-filters to Instagram nodes.

criteria.title: Trigger node
criteria.text: Given a workspace with a connected number and a Trigger with no sender, when Save is clicked, then save is blocked with the "Trigger node has no number selected" reason; given no connected numbers, the same flow saves with an amber hint shown.

criteria.title: Trigger node
criteria.text: Given kind `comment_to_dm` with two rules ticked, then `keywordRuleIds` holds both ids; with none ticked the card still shows "on comment -> DM" and the flow is a catch-all for Comment -> DM rules.

criteria.title: Send message node
criteria.text: Given a new Send message node, then the text is the placeholder default, the card shows it in a bubble and the node exposes one output labelled "next".

criteria.title: Send message node
criteria.text: Given the text `*Hello* {{name}}`, then the inspector preview shows "Hello" in bold followed by the variable token, and the card bubble truncates the text at 140 characters with an ellipsis.

criteria.title: Send message node
criteria.text: Given the admin types `/` in the field, then the attribute popover opens and choosing "name" inserts `{{name}}` at the caret.

criteria.title: Send message node
criteria.text: Given a flow whose Trigger channel is switched to a call flow, then Send message is not in the palette; if already on the canvas and the channel changes, Save is blocked with the "does not work on" message (TW-FLB-018).

criteria.title: Send message node
criteria.text: Given the normalizer runs on `{type:'message', data:{text:'Hi'}}`, then the output node has `flowNodeType` Message and one Text reply with data `Hi`.

criteria.title: Send sequence node
criteria.text: Given the default node, then the card shows one chip "1. Hi {{name}}! TEXT", and adding Image then Video yields chips 2 and 3 in that order; moving reply 3 up swaps them.

criteria.title: Send sequence node
criteria.text: Given a media reply and a successful upload, then `url` and `filename` are set and the inspector shows the thumbnail (image) or type chip with a link; given a failed upload, the toast "Upload failed: HTTP 413" (or the HTTP status) is shown and the reply is unchanged.

criteria.title: Send sequence node
criteria.text: Given six replies, then the card lists five chips and "+ 1 more...".

criteria.title: Send sequence node
criteria.text: Given the normaliser input with replies `[text, image]`, then the output has two `flowReplies` (Text with data, Image with absolute URL, filename and caption).

criteria.title: Send media node
criteria.text: Given Type Image and a successful upload, then `url` and `filename` are set, the inspector shows a thumbnail and the card shows a thumbnail tile.

criteria.title: Send media node
criteria.text: Given Type Document with filename `catalogue.pdf` and a pasted HTTPS URL, then the card shows `catalogue.pdf` with "document" and the normaliser output has `mediaKind=document` and the URL unchanged.

criteria.title: Send media node
criteria.text: Given a relative stored URL `/storage/flows/a.png`, then the normalised `mediaUrl` is an absolute `https://<app-domain>/storage/flows/a.png`; given `{{invoice_url}}`, it is left as is.

criteria.title: Send media node
criteria.text: Given an upload that returns HTTP 500, then the toast "Upload failed: HTTP 500" appears and the previous file is kept.

criteria.title: Send template node
criteria.text: Given a workspace with approved template "welcome" with two quick-reply buttons and one URL button, when it is picked, then `tpl='welcome'`, `tplId` is its id, and the card shows ports "Yes" and "No" (the two quick replies) but none for the URL button.

criteria.title: Send template node
criteria.text: Given a template with no quick-reply buttons, then the node has the single output "next".

criteria.title: Send template node
criteria.text: Given a template name that is not in the workspace list, then the select shows "<name> (not in workspace)" and the preview says the template was not found.

criteria.title: Send template node
criteria.text: Given the normaliser runs on a node with `tplId` pointing to a row, then the output carries `templateBody`, `templateButtons` and `templateVariableMap` from that row, and edge handle `p1` becomes source `<id>_2`.

criteria.title: Quick replies (buttons) node
criteria.text: Given a new node, then it exposes ports `p0` "Option A" and `p1` "Option B" and the hint reads "Max 3 buttons...".

criteria.title: Quick replies (buttons) node
criteria.text: Given three buttons, when the admin clicks Add button, then the toast "Max 3 quick reply buttons" shows and the list stays at three.

criteria.title: Quick replies (buttons) node
criteria.text: Given edges from `p0`->X, `p1`->Y, `p2`->Z, when the admin removes option 2 (index 1), then the edge to Y is deleted, the edge to Z now leaves `p1`, and the node exposes two ports.

criteria.title: Quick replies (buttons) node
criteria.text: Given the normaliser runs, then an edge with handle `p1` becomes `sourceNodeId <id>_2` and `buttons` holds `[{id:'p0',...},{id:'p1',...}]`.

criteria.title: List message node
criteria.text: Given three items where items 1 and 2 share the section "Drinks" and item 3 has none, then the preview shows two headings and the helper text "Renders as 2 sections: Drinks x 2 . (no heading) x 1", while ports remain `p0,p1,p2`.

criteria.title: List message node
criteria.text: Given ten items, when Add item is clicked, then the toast "Max 10 items" appears and nothing is added.

criteria.title: List message node
criteria.text: Given a title typed beyond 24 characters, then the input refuses further characters (maxlength) and the counter shows 24/24; given an imported flow with a 40-character title, then the normalised `listItems[i].title` has 24 characters.

criteria.title: List message node
criteria.text: Given a saved flow whose options are bare strings, then the inspector shows each as a title with empty description and section.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given a new Ask node, then it shows one output "reply received", variable `answer`, Validate as "Free text", and no expected answers.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given two expected answers "Yes" and "No", then the node exposes `p0` "Yes", `p1` "No" and `else` "else / no match"; a fourth Add click is blocked with "Max 3 expected answers" after three.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given the variable field holds `{{email}}`, then the normalised `variable` is `email`.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given `acceptMedia` on, then the normalised node has `acceptMedia=true`.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given an edge with handle `else`, then the normalised `sourceNodeId` is `<id>_0`.

criteria.title: Ask question node
criteria.text: Given Validate as Email and a reply "not an email", then (reference behaviour) the reply is accepted without validation; the port must instead re-prompt or take the else path.

criteria.title: Condition node
criteria.text: Given a new Condition, then it shows "IF {{?}} = ?" style preview, ports `yes` and `no`, and one rule with operator Equal to.

criteria.title: Condition node
criteria.text: Given the operator Is set, then the value input disappears and the card shows "is set".

criteria.title: Condition node
criteria.text: Given two rules joined by OR, when the first rule is removed, then one rule remains and `operators` is empty; the last remaining rule has no remove button.

criteria.title: Condition node
criteria.text: Given rules `plan = pro` AND `age gt 18`, then the normaliser outputs `logicOperators:['AND']`, flat `variable='plan'`, `compareValue='pro'`, and an edge handle `no` becomes `sourceNodeId <id>_2`.

criteria.title: Condition node
criteria.text: Given a customer value "Pro " for variable plan and the rule `plan equals pro`, then (runtime) the condition is true.

criteria.title: Wait (delay) node
criteria.text: Given amount 2 and unit hours, then the card reads "Wait 2 hour" and the normalised `delaySeconds` is 7200.

criteria.title: Wait (delay) node
criteria.text: Given an empty amount, then the normaliser output is 5 minutes (300 seconds).

criteria.title: Wait (delay) node
criteria.text: Given unit days and amount 1, then `delaySeconds` is 86400; given an unknown unit value from an imported flow, then it is treated as minutes.

criteria.title: Wait (delay) node
criteria.text: Given amount 0.5 minutes, then `delaySeconds` is 0 and the node does not delay.

criteria.title: Webhook node
criteria.text: Given a new node, then it shows POST, empty URL, JSON content type, response variable `response` and one output "response".

criteria.title: Webhook node
criteria.text: Given a header row with an empty key, then the normaliser drops it; given `save` = `{{res}}`, then `variable` is `res`.

criteria.title: Webhook node
criteria.text: Given a webhook returning `{"stock":4}` saved as `response`, then (runtime) `{{response.stock}}` resolves to `4` in later nodes.

criteria.title: Webhook node
criteria.text: Given a URL resolving to a private IP, then (runtime) the call is refused, the variable becomes empty and the flow continues on `out`.

criteria.title: Webhook node
criteria.text: Given a JSON-object body with no `_threadwise` key, then the receiver gets the context envelope under `_threadwise`.

criteria.title: Run code (JS) node
criteria.text: Given a new node, then the default sample code is shown, `save` is `result` and the card shows "JS" and "save -> {{result}}".

criteria.title: Run code (JS) node
criteria.text: Given code that returns `{total: 3}` and save `calc`, then (runtime) `{{calc.total}}` is `3` afterwards.

criteria.title: Run code (JS) node
criteria.text: Given code with an infinite loop, then (runtime) it is aborted at about 2 seconds, `{{result}}` holds an error object and the flow continues.

criteria.title: Run code (JS) node
criteria.text: Given a Facebook flow, then the node is not in the palette and an existing one is flagged on save.

criteria.title: MySQL query node
criteria.text: Given `SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE sku = '{{sku}}'` and a reachable DB, then (runtime) the variable `rows` holds a JSON array and `{{rows.0.qty}}` resolves.

criteria.title: MySQL query node
criteria.text: Given the SQL `DELETE FROM x`, then the endpoint returns 422 "Only SELECT queries are allowed." and the flow continues with an empty `rows`.

criteria.title: MySQL query node
criteria.text: Given `SELECT 1; SELECT 2`, then 422 "Only a single statement is allowed."; given a query returning 500 rows, then only the first 100 are returned.

criteria.title: MySQL query node
criteria.text: Given a wrong host, then 502 "Query failed: ..." after at most 8 s and the flow continues.

criteria.title: MySQL query node
criteria.text: Given a request without the node token, then 401.

criteria.title: AI assistant node
criteria.text: Given the platform enabled OpenAI (default gpt-4o-mini) and Anthropic, then the Model list shows "OpenAI . gpt-4o-mini" and "Anthropic . <default>" and picking one writes the raw model id.

criteria.title: AI assistant node
criteria.text: Given the workspace added its own OpenAI key, then the OpenAI entries become "OpenAI (your key) . gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4o" and the platform OpenAI models disappear.

criteria.title: AI assistant node
criteria.text: Given Extract on with fields `NAME, DATE`, then the normalised node has `extract=true` and `fields=['NAME','DATE']` and the inspector hint mentions `{{reply.KEY}}`.

criteria.title: AI assistant node
criteria.text: Given Conversation mode off, then the Exit keyword field is hidden; switched on, it appears and is stored as `exit_keyword`.

criteria.title: AI assistant node
criteria.text: Given the ai-call endpoint without a configured key for the provider, then 502 `provider_failed` with a message naming the provider.

criteria.title: Tag contact node
criteria.text: Given an existing tag "Hot lead" picked, then the node stores `tagId` and `tag='Hot lead'`, the card pill shows its colour, and renaming the tag elsewhere updates the card text after reload.

criteria.title: Tag contact node
criteria.text: Given the admin types "New tag" in the text field, then `tagId` is cleared and the card pill shows "New tag" with the "new" marker.

criteria.title: Tag contact node
criteria.text: Given the callback with `action=add` and `tag_name='Promo'` that does not exist, then a tag "Promo" with colour `#075E54` is created, attached to the conversation, and a `tag_added` event with source `flow` exists.

criteria.title: Tag contact node
criteria.text: Given the callback for a number with no conversation, then 404 `conversation_not_found`.

criteria.title: Tag contact node
criteria.text: Given `tag_id` of another workspace and no name, then 422 `tag_unresolved`.

criteria.title: Assign agent node
criteria.text: Given team "Support" (3 agents) is picked and no agent, when the node fires, then the conversation is assigned per the team's strategy and the response has an `assignee_user_id`.

criteria.title: Assign agent node
criteria.text: Given a specific agent is picked, then assignment strategy is `manual` and that user is the assignee.

criteria.title: Assign agent node
criteria.text: Given a team id from another workspace in the payload, then 422 with "That team is not part of this workspace." and no assignment change.

criteria.title: Assign agent node
criteria.text: Given the note "VIP, call back", then a `note_added` event with that text and source `flow` exists on the conversation.

criteria.title: Assign agent node
criteria.text: Given the admin changes the team after picking an agent, then (reference) the stored `userId` stays; the port must clear or validate it.

criteria.title: Run sub-flow node
criteria.text: Given a workspace with flows "Welcome" (live) and "FAQ" (draft), then the dropdown offers "Welcome . live" and "FAQ . draft", excluding the flow being edited.

criteria.title: Run sub-flow node
criteria.text: Given a picked flow that is later deleted, then the card reads "run Flow #<id>" and the inspector shows "Flow #<id> (not in workspace)".

criteria.title: Run sub-flow node
criteria.text: Given the normaliser output for `{flow:'42'}`, then the node has `flowNodeType` SubFlow and `flowId='42'`.

criteria.title: Run sub-flow node
criteria.text: Given a sub-flow id that belongs to another workspace, then the port must reject it at save/publish (the reference runtime does not).

criteria.title: End node
criteria.text: Given an End node on the canvas, then its card shows "flow ends here" and exposes no output port; dragging from it is impossible.

criteria.title: End node

criteria.text: Given a template send, then nothing is translated.

criteria.title: Outbound reply auto-translate
criteria.text: Given all providers fail, then the original text is sent.

criteria.text: Given an unknown single-segment path that matches the slug regex but no workspace, Then 404.

criteria.text: Given `DEMO_MODE=true` and a signed-in user, When a POST goes to a non-allow-listed path, Then it is refused with the demo message; When the same write is made through `/api/v1/*` with an API key, Then it is NOT refused (demo lock is web-only).

criteria.title: Web request middleware stack: ordered reference with skip conditions

criteria.text: Given the installer is incomplete, When any non-`/install` URL is requested, Then it redirects to `/install` before a session is started.

criteria.text: Given `TRUSTED_PROXIES` is unset, When a request carries `X-Forwarded-For: 1.2.3.4`, Then the app treats 1.2.3.4 as the client IP (documented spoofable default).

criteria.text: Given `TRUSTED_PROXIES=10.0.0.0/8` and a request from outside that range carrying `X-Forwarded-For`, Then the header is ignored and the peer address is used.

criteria.title: Trusted proxies and real-client-IP resolution
criteria.text: Given a TLS-terminating proxy sending `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`, When the app builds a URL, Then it uses `https`.

criteria.title: Request-derived base URL, scheme forcing and sub-folder installs
criteria.text: Given the app is served at `https://host/public/`, When a page is rendered, Then all links and form actions begin with `/public` and a root-relative `fetch('/devices')` becomes `/public/devices`.

criteria.title: Request-derived base URL, scheme forcing and sub-folder installs
criteria.text: Given an HTTPS site behind a proxy that forwards plain HTTP with `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`, Then generated URLs are `https`.

criteria.title: Request-derived base URL, scheme forcing and sub-folder installs
criteria.text: Given the app is at a domain root, Then the client patch is inert and no prefix is added.

criteria.title: Request-derived base URL, scheme forcing and sub-folder installs
criteria.text: Given a root `.htaccess` that rewrites internally to `/public`, When the browser URL has no `/public`, Then no `/public` prefix is emitted.

criteria.title: CSRF policy and the exemption catalogue
criteria.text: Given a signed-in user's POST to a normal page with no token, When handled, Then it is rejected as CSRF mismatch (TW-INFRA-008 turns that into a redirect for browsers).

criteria.title: CSRF policy and the exemption catalogue
criteria.text: Given a POST to `team-inbox/api/...` with the session cookie but no token, Then it is accepted (and fails only on auth/authorization).

criteria.title: CSRF policy and the exemption catalogue

criteria.title: CSRF policy and the exemption catalogue
criteria.text: Given a request to a Node callback without the Node token, Then it is rejected by the token check even though CSRF is exempt.

criteria.title: Decline invitation

criteria.text: Given a workspace with a connected WABA number, a Baileys device and a connected Instagram account, When the page renders, Then the device filter offers three options with values `waba:<id>`, `baileys:<id>`, `instagram:<id>`.

criteria.title: Team Inbox page shell (`GET /team-inbox`)
criteria.text: Given a workspace with zero conversations and a user holding `team.manage`, When the first queue response arrives, Then the getting-started panel shows instead of the empty-selection dashboard.

criteria.title: Team Inbox page shell (`GET /team-inbox`)
criteria.text: Given a WABA template that is not APPROVED, When the composer Template tab is built, Then that template is absent while an unapproved Instagram template is present.

criteria.text: Given an Agent-role user, When bootstrap is called, Then `permissions['inbox.assign_self']` is true and `permissions['inbox.assign']` is false.

criteria.title: Inbox bootstrap payload (`GET /team-inbox/api/bootstrap`)
