criteria.title: Inbox bootstrap payload (`GET /team-inbox/api/bootstrap`)
criteria.text: Given a personal saved reply of user A, When user B calls bootstrap, Then it is absent from B's `saved_replies`.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given 40 open conversations and `per_page=30`, When the queue is requested, Then 30 items return with `has_more=true`; with `per_page=60` all 40 return and `has_more=false`.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given a pinned conversation with an old `last_message_at`, When the list is returned, Then it sorts above newer unpinned conversations.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given nothing changed since the last full payload, When the client repeats the request with the returned `sig`, Then the response is `{unchanged:true}` with no items.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given `device_id=waba:5` and a Baileys device also numbered 5, When filtered, Then only provider `waba` threads with device_id 5 return.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given a Viewer without `inbox.view_all_teams` and `tab=all`, When listed, Then only threads assigned to them or to teams they belong to return.

criteria.title: Conversation queue API (`GET /team-inbox/api/queue`)
criteria.text: Given `q=acme`, When a conversation's decrypted title contains "Acme", Then it is returned even though SQL cannot match the encrypted column.

criteria.title: Queue tab counts and role-based visibility
criteria.text: Given three open conversations (one mine, two unassigned) and one resolved mine, When counts are read, Then mine=1, unassigned=2, all=3.

criteria.title: Queue tab counts and role-based visibility
criteria.text: Given a note that @mentions me on an archived resolved thread, When counts are read, Then mentions still includes it.

criteria.title: Queue tab counts and role-based visibility
criteria.text: Given a Viewer in team T with one thread assigned to T, When counts are read, Then `all` = 1 and the other workspace threads are not counted.

criteria.title: Queue list UI, channel rail, alerts and polling
criteria.text: Given a message arrives on a non-open, non-muted conversation, When the next poll returns, Then one ping plays and (tab hidden) a desktop notification appears; a muted conversation produces neither.

criteria.title: Queue list UI, channel rail, alerts and polling
criteria.text: Given the operator switches from All to Unread while an All request is in flight, When the slower All response lands, Then it is discarded and the Unread list stays.

criteria.title: Queue list UI, channel rail, alerts and polling
criteria.text: Given a list scrolled to the bottom with `has_more=true`, When scrolling near the end, Then the next request asks for `per_page` 30 higher.

criteria.title: Conversation visibility scoping (engine set, agnostic channels, live devices)
criteria.text: Given a workspace whose enabled engine set is only `baileys`, When a WABA thread exists but no WABA config is connected, Then it is not listed.

criteria.title: Conversation visibility scoping (engine set, agnostic channels, live devices)
criteria.text: Given a Baileys thread whose device was deleted, When the queue loads, Then it is hidden; When a device with that id exists again, Then it reappears.

criteria.title: Conversation visibility scoping (engine set, agnostic channels, live devices)
criteria.text: Given an Instagram account is disconnected, When the queue loads within 5 s cache expiry, Then Instagram threads disappear from the list and counts.

criteria.title: Scheduler-less sweeps piggy-backed on the queue poll
criteria.text: Given a snoozed thread with `snoozed_until` in the past and an operator polling the queue, When the poll completes, Then within the same or next poll the thread is `open`, an `auto_unsnoozed` event exists and the assignee got a `snooze_wake` notification.

criteria.title: Scheduler-less sweeps piggy-backed on the queue poll
criteria.text: Given two operators polling simultaneously, When the 30 s gate is set by the first, Then the second poll schedules no duplicate sweep.

criteria.title: Global unread bell and "last seen" watermark
criteria.text: Given a user who has never polled, When the first poll happens, Then total is 0 and the watermark is set.

criteria.title: Global unread bell and "last seen" watermark
criteria.text: Given a customer message after the watermark, When the bell polls, Then total=1 and the item preview is the first 80 chars.

criteria.title: Global unread bell and "last seen" watermark
criteria.text: Given the user opens `/team-inbox`, When the bell next polls elsewhere, Then total is 0 until a newer inbound arrives.

criteria.title: Open a conversation (`GET /team-inbox/api/conversations/{id}`)
criteria.text: Given a thread with 142 messages, When it is opened, Then the newest 80 return oldest-first, `has_more=true`, and unread_count becomes 0.

criteria.title: Open a conversation (`GET /team-inbox/api/conversations/{id}`)
criteria.text: Given `before=<id of oldest loaded>`, When requested, Then the previous 80 (or fewer) return without notes/events and without changing unread state.

criteria.title: Open a conversation (`GET /team-inbox/api/conversations/{id}`)
criteria.text: Given a Viewer not assigned and not in the thread's team, When they request the id, Then the response is 403; a conversation of another workspace returns 404.

criteria.title: Open a conversation (`GET /team-inbox/api/conversations/{id}`)
criteria.text: Given the same phone appears in two threads (different business numbers), When one is opened, Then `history` lists the other.

criteria.title: Thread delta polling and older-message paging

criteria.title: Thread delta polling and older-message paging
criteria.text: Given nothing changed, When polling, Then the DOM (and any playing audio) is untouched.

criteria.title: QR pairing flow
criteria.text: Given a disconnected device and a running bridge, When the user clicks Connect -> Scan QR, Then a QR renders within ~30 s and the progress strip starts polling every 1.5 s.

criteria.title: QR pairing flow
criteria.text: Given the phone scans the QR of the same number, When the bridge reports Ready, Then the row becomes `connected` with `last_seen_at` set and the modal closes.

criteria.title: QR pairing flow
criteria.text: Given the QR is not scanned for 90 s, When the stall timer fires, Then the session folder is deleted and the status becomes "Pair failed: QR timeout".

criteria.title: QR pairing flow
criteria.text: Given a QR scanned by a phone logged in as a different number, When the socket opens, Then the bridge logs out, wipes the session and reports "Mismatch", and the row does not become connected.

criteria.title: Pairing-code flow
criteria.text: Given a disconnected device, When the user requests a pairing code, Then an 8-character code is shown in `XXXX-XXXX` form and progress polling starts.

criteria.title: Pairing-code flow
criteria.text: Given the user re-requests within 120 s of the first code, When the endpoint is called again, Then the same code is returned.

criteria.title: Pairing-code flow
criteria.text: Given the number is already connected, When requesting a code, Then the UI toasts "Already connected." and closes the modal.

criteria.title: Pairing-code flow
criteria.text: Given a number with fewer than 8 digits, When requesting, Then the bridge fails and the UI shows "Pairing code failed".

criteria.title: Connection status polling and manual mark-connected

criteria.title: Connection status polling and manual mark-connected

criteria.title: Edit device details

criteria.title: Disconnect (kill session)

criteria.title: Disconnect (kill session)

criteria.title: Delete device

criteria.title: Manual and background status check with grace window
criteria.text: Given a previously disconnected device the bridge reports ready, When check runs, Then it is promoted to connected and the "Device connected" notification fires.

criteria.title: Device status change fan-out (notification, webhook, audit, broadcast)

criteria.title: Device status change fan-out (notification, webhook, audit, broadcast)

criteria.title: Node status callback (`api/update-status`)
criteria.text: Given the bridge posts "Logged Out", When processed, Then config and device rows become disconnected.

criteria.text: Given the bridge posts "Connecting", When processed, Then the config is pending and devices become `needs_pair`.

criteria.title: Node heartbeat: liveness, stale sweep, idle logout

criteria.title: Node heartbeat: liveness, stale sweep, idle logout
criteria.text: Given no live devices, When the bridge timer fires, Then no request is sent.

criteria.text: Given a fresh number, When a QR is requested and scanned by the same number, Then creds are saved, the mismatch guard passes, the manager becomes ready and "Ready" is reported.

criteria.title: Baileys session lifecycle in the Node bridge
criteria.text: Given the socket closes with 515 right after the scan, When the handler runs, Then a reconnect is scheduled in about 2 s plus jitter and the pairing is not aborted.

criteria.title: Baileys session lifecycle in the Node bridge
criteria.text: Given the socket closes with 401 after connection, When the handler runs, Then the session folder is removed and "Logged Out" is reported and no reconnect is attempted.

criteria.title: Baileys session lifecycle in the Node bridge
criteria.text: Given a network drop, When the socket closes with code 408, Then reconnect attempts continue indefinitely with the capped 30 s backoff until logout.

criteria.title: Baileys session lifecycle in the Node bridge
criteria.text: Given two closes within 100 ms, When both schedule reconnects, Then only one reconnect timer survives.

criteria.title: Session persistence, auto-restore and graceful shutdown
criteria.text: Given a saved folder with 2 files, When the bridge starts, Then it is not restored and "Disconnected" is posted for that number.

criteria.title: Session persistence, auto-restore and graceful shutdown
criteria.text: Given SIGTERM, When the bridge stops, Then session files remain and the next start restores them.

criteria.title: Node bridge client-control API and API auth guard
criteria.text: Given `terminate-client` on an unknown number, When called, Then `{status:'not_found'}`.

criteria.title: Node bridge client-control API and API auth guard
criteria.text: Given a valid token from a remote host, When calling `client-status`, Then the live state JSON is returned.
